summary: Iran reportedly struck three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, with satellite imagery showing a massive smoke plume from one vessel at coordinates 26.12531, 55.91655. The IDF withdrew the 98th Division headquarters from the West Bank after 1,500 counter-terror operations, while Israeli forces uncovered Hezbollah weapons caches within 250 meters of UNIFIL positions in southern Lebanon. The USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier group is transiting toward the Middle East as the US maintains a two-carrier presence, and emergency warnings were activated in Riyadh and Dammam, Saudi Arabia.
key_points: Iran struck three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz on 08/11/2026; Sentinel-2 imagery shows a massive smoke plume at coordinates 26.12531, 55.91655. (Source: @shin_persian/12137)

IDF 98th Division HQ completed West Bank mission after 1,500 operations, 140 arrests, 35 weapons seized; two soldiers killed near Hebron; division now General Staff reserve. (Source: @manniefabian/59487)

Israeli forces found Hezbollah weapons caches in Mis al-Jabal and Aita al-Shaab, including Kalashnikovs, rockets, RPGs, machine guns, grenades, IED, and ammo, 200–250 meters from UNIFIL posts. (Source: @N12chat/234010)

USS Theodore Roosevelt CSG departed Singapore, transiting Strait of Malacca at 22.7 knots, expected mid-November in CENTCOM, likely to replace USS George H.W. Bush and maintain two-carrier posture. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9774)
UKMTO issued Warning 199-26 for maritime security in the region, reflecting heightened threat to commercial shipping. (Source: @shin_persian/12133)
Emergency warnings activated in Riyadh and Dammam, Saudi Arabia, per Saudi Civil Defense alerts. (Source: @shin_persian/12131, @shin_persian/12129)

Israeli artillery shelled Aita al-Jabal, Zutar al-Sharqiya, and Yamar al-Shaqif in southern Lebanon; fighter jets repeatedly tracked south; Red Alerts at Zarit, Shomera, Nir Oz. (Source: @redlinkleb/52156, @redlinkleb/52147, @redlinkleb/52158, @tzevaadom_en/68573, @tzevaadom_en/68576)

Jet activity observed over Baghdad, Iraq; US BACN aircraft at Prince Sultan Air Base, Saudi Arabia; KC-46 refueled P-8A southeast of Qatar. (Source: @shin_persian/12141, @shin_persian/12125, @shin_persian/12127)

points: Iranian forces reportedly struck three oil tankers in the southern Strait of Hormuz on 08/11/2026; Sentinel-2 satellite imagery captured a massive smoke plume rising from one vessel at coordinates 26.12531, 55.91655. (Source: @shin_persian/12137)
Iranian media reported an oil tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @N12chat/234006)
Former US President Trump stated the US could destroy 38 bridges in Iran within an hour but prefers to avoid it, noting three aircraft carriers are fully ready. (Source: @amitsegal/66963)
US Air Force KC-46 aerial refueling a US Navy P-8A southeast of Qatar, indicating persistent maritime patrol and reconnaissance operations. (Source: @shin_persian/12127)
UKMTO issued Warning 199-26 for maritime security in the region, reflecting heightened threat to commercial shipping. (Source: @shin_persian/12133)

IDF withdrew the 98th Division headquarters from the West Bank on 08/11/2026 after a month-long deployment commanding the Judea and Etzion regional brigades, during which forces conducted over 1,500 counter-terror operations, apprehended 140 suspects, and seized approximately 35 weapons. (Source: @manniefabian/59487)

Two IDF soldiers, Staff Sgt. Ron Yehonatan Reitman and Sgt. Yuval Shai Suilam, were killed in a shooting attack at a checkpoint near Hebron during the division's tenure. (Source: @yediotnews25/137478)

Israeli warplanes conducted multiple sorties over southern Lebanon, with live tracking showing fighter jets heading south repeatedly throughout the day. (Source: @redlinkleb/52142, @redlinkleb/52145, @redlinkleb/52112)

Israeli artillery shelled several locations in southern Lebanon including Aita al-Jabal, Zutar al-Sharqiya, and the vicinity of Yamar al-Shaqif, where illumination bombs were also dropped. (Source: @redlinkleb/52156, @redlinkleb/52147, @redlinkleb/52158)

A hostile aircraft intrusion triggered Red Alert sirens at the Confrontation Line communities of Zarit and Shomera at 06:10, and later at Nir Oz in the Gaza envelope at 18:53. (Source: @tzevaadom_en/68573, @tzevaadom_en/68576)

IDF discovered Hezbollah weapons caches in civilian homes and a warehouse in Mis al-Jabal and Aita al-Shaab, including Kalashnikov rifles, rockets, RPGs, machine guns, grenades, an IED, and ammunition, located 200–250 meters from UNIFIL positions. (Source: @N12chat/234010)

The 98th Division headquarters concluded its operational command over the Judea and Samaria regional brigades after 45 days, having executed more than 1,500 counter-terrorism activities, arrested over 140 suspects, and confiscated roughly 35 firearms. (Source: @yediotnews25/137478)
During the deployment, two soldiers were killed in a firefight at a checkpoint on the outskirts of Hebron, which the IDF said prevented a major attack. (Source: @yediotnews25/137478)
A Red Alert siren activated at Nir Oz in the Gaza envelope at 18:53 with a 15-second warning time, indicating a projectile threat from Gaza. (Source: @tzevaadom_en/68576)
The IDF stated the 98th Division will now serve as the General Staff reserve, focusing on readiness and preparation for future scenarios. (Source: @manniefabian/59487)

Israeli artillery conducted shelling on Aita al-Jabal, Zutar al-Sharqiya (multiple strikes), and dropped illumination bombs toward Yamar al-Shaqif in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/52156, @redlinkleb/52147, @redlinkleb/52158)
Israeli fighter jets were repeatedly tracked flying south toward Lebanese airspace throughout the day. (Source: @redlinkleb/52142, @redlinkleb/52145, @redlinkleb/52112)

IDF troops uncovered Hezbollah weapons caches in the villages of Mis al-Jabal and Aita al-Shaab, including Kalashnikov rifles, rockets, RPG launchers, machine guns, fragmentation grenades, an improvised explosive device, and ammunition, all within 200–250 meters of UNIFIL outposts. (Source: @N12chat/234010)
Humanitarian aid boxes were found at one of the Hezbollah sites, which the IDF cited as evidence of civilian infrastructure exploitation and UNIFIL inaction. (Source: @N12chat/234010)
Red Alert sirens sounded at the Confrontation Line communities of Zarit and Shomera at 06:10 due to hostile aircraft intrusion. (Source: @tzevaadom_en/68573)
Jet activity was observed over Baghdad, Iraq, indicating possible coalition or Iraqi air operations. (Source: @shin_persian/12141)

US Air Force BACN (Battlefield Airborne Communications Node) aircraft was noted on the ground at Prince Sultan Air Base in Saudi Arabia, supporting regional command and control. (Source: @shin_persian
